about: The tier-1 gate's dated allowlist of known failures (tools/orchestration/tier1_gate.py; REVIEW_REPORT H12 G2-ABS). Every test passes and every authored spec passes in its own mode, except an entry here: {"kind": "test", "test": "tests.test_x.Class[.test_name]", "modes": ["normal", "strict", "isolated", "core", "golden", "golden_all"] (default all), "owner", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason"} or {"kind": "spec", "catalog_id", "seeds": [..] or "all", "mode": "own" | "realistic" | "both" (default own), "owner", "expires", "reason"}. An expired or malformed entry excuses nothing. Main session only: the gate reads the committed version (git HEAD) and fails G10 for any package that edits this file.
